title: SKILLS-DOSSIER
universal_lens: The operational architecture is a constrained dynamical system where autonomous agents function as state-transition operators. Resource allocation acts as a hard boundary condition, enforcing strict energy minimization via ephemeral compute instances, while universal handoff protocols establish an invariant information manifold across disjointed computational domains.
gsi_mapping: GSI utilizes the guardrailed RAG retrieval as a conformal prediction set generator. By strictly bounding agent responses to verified knowledge bases, it enforces exact coverage guarantees on epistemic uncertainty, treating unverified pricing or policy queries as high-risk outliers requiring immediate rejection under strict calibration constraints.
gse_mapping: GSE maps visual situational reasoning to a Markov Decision Process over pixel-space embeddings. The VSS video-understanding operator extracts latent state vectors from real footage, driving Bayesian updates in the predictive engine while adhering to hard-rule compliance by rejecting generative hallucinations.

primitives.name: Ephemeral Compute Budget Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Treat every GPU job as capped: spin up, run the batch, tear down.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C(t): instantaneous compute cost (USD), T_run: runtime duration (hours), C_max: maximum allowable budget cap (USD).
primitives.assumptions: Compute resources are strictly metered and non-renewable within a given temporal window; tearing down instances yields zero marginal cost.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System fails if T_run exceeds the threshold where integral of C(t) surpasses C_max, or if persistent background processes prevent clean termination.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a time-constrained optimization problem in GSE where model inference must complete before market closure, mapping Brev instance lifecycle to finite-horizon control theory.
layer2.telemetry: Average GPU active hours per batch job vs. total allocated quota.

primitives.name: Universal Handoff Manifold
primitives.verbatim_quote: nemo-rl-session-memory — cost: FREE **What it is.** Not a server — an agent workflow playbook.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S_t: system state at time t (dimensionless vector), H(S_t): handoff protocol function, M: shared markdown representation space.
primitives.assumptions: All autonomous agents share a common semantic understanding of the markdown representation space; state transitions are lossless when serialized into M.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if an agent introduces novel state variables that cannot be faithfully serialized into the established playbook format, causing information leakage.

layer2.mapping: Derives a unified state-transfer kernel for GSI/GSE, allowing disparate microservices (e.g., IG DM watcher and sports calibration research) to exchange context without bespoke API glue.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of cross-agent tasks completed without manual intervention or context loss.

primitives.name: Guardrailed Retrieval Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: $350 Kit sites + kit-dm-watcher (IG DM lead watcher, draft-reply mode), SignPreview B2B, Vow & Post wedding signage, Recordly video, affiliate lane.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Q: user query (string), D: domain knowledge base (set of documents), A: generated answer (string), P(hallucination|D): probability of generating text outside D.
primitives.assumptions: The knowledge base D is exhaustive for the permitted domain; the retrieval mechanism has perfect recall for relevant grounding facts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the query Q requires synthesis of information not explicitly present in D, forcing the model to either hallucinate or return a null response.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSI's strict calibration layer, acting as a hard constraint filter that rejects any probabilistic output lacking direct empirical citation from the arXiv corpus.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of rejected queries due to missing citations in the target knowledge base.

This forces all downstream operators, such as the 'Universal Handoff Manifold', to optimize for efficiency and state preservation. The handoff mechanism acts as a topological invariant, ensuring that despite the transient nature of the compute instances (spin up/tear down), the informational continuity of the agent's task remains intact across disjoint temporal intervals. 

Furthermore, the 'Guardrailed Retrieval Kernel' introduces a rigorous epistemic boundary condition. In both the revenue engine and the sports intelligence domain, this kernel functions as a projection operator, mapping high-dimensional generative possibilities onto a lower-dimensional subspace strictly defined by verified ground truth (the knowledge base). This prevents the system from drifting into hallucinatory states, effectively minimizing the entropy of the output distribution by anchoring it to explicit citations. The interplay between these three primitives reveals a dual structure: one governing the physical/resource layer (compute budgets) and the other governing the logical/semantic layer (handoffs and retrieval). The failure modes of this system are thus clearly delineated: either a violation of the resource cap leading to abrupt termination, or a breach of the epistemic boundary resulting in ungrounded outputs. The 'wildest play' of a universal handoff format essentially proposes a grand unified theory for these micro-agents, suggesting that diverse operational goals can be reduced to a single, standardized state-transition language.

The ephemeral compute model echoes the economic principles of spot-instance markets in cloud computing, while the guardrailed retrieval is a direct descendant of symbolic AI's commitment to verifiable logic, modernized through vector-space embeddings and attention mechanisms. reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: From a theory of mind perspective, the system models opposing agents—namely, the cost-optimizing infrastructure versus the capability-maximizing application logic. The infrastructure acts as a restrictive environment, constantly threatening to terminate processes that exceed budgetary thresholds. Conversely, the application agents (like the Kit Receptionist or GSE predictor) strive to maintain persistent context and maximize informational yield. The universal handoff protocol serves as a negotiated treaty between these opposing forces, allowing the agents to survive infrastructure culling by efficiently serializing their cognitive state.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical cross-layer veto condition arises if the semantic complexity of the 'Universal Handoff Manifold' begins to bloat, introducing latency that violates the strict temporal constraints of the 'Ephemeral Compute Budget'. If the serialization/deserialization of state becomes computationally expensive, it creates a feedback loop where preserving context consumes the very resources meant to execute the task. Additionally, if the 'Guardrailed Retrieval Kernel' becomes too restrictive, it may veto valid, synthesized insights that fall just outside the explicit boundaries of the knowledge base, leading to a degradation in the system's overall predictive power.
